scope: CPU-only prepare-time microbenchmark. One process, Python 3.12, 1 warmup then 10 measured calls per method per layout, alternating order. Generated inputs and page table outside timed section. 64 queries; actual 950 device timing unchanged.
shape: rows i=0..63, length 2048 for shared/rotated or 2048-13*i for ragged
formula: block=(37*j+offset)%2048; offset=0 for shared and 19*i otherwise; PA128 table maps page p to (31*p+1)%128
parity: 300 seeded random ragged inputs, each with and without physical page table, full return dictionary equal
